oracle.grammar: bias-free low-rank residual I + U V^T
oracle.rank_definition: minimum truncated-SVD rank whose relative Frobenius reconstruction error is <=1e-10

regimes.independent: two generic independent rank-4 residual maps; null expectation composed residual rank 8 and cost ratio approximately 1
regimes.shared_subspace: two rank-4 residual maps sharing left/right subspaces; positive-control expectation composed residual rank <=4 and cost ratio <=0.5
regimes.inverse_cancellation: second map exact inverse of first; positive-control expectation identity composition, rank 0 and cost ratio 0

stopping_rule: Run the fixed 64 seeds in all three regimes exactly once. Do not change numerical-rank tolerances, thresholds, scales, or regime construction after outcomes.
scope_boundary: Synthetic linear residual rank oracle only; not neural-network MDL, Kolmogorov complexity, task utility, or learned-optimizer evidence.
